items.title: August 2026 apps release notes
items.metaDescription: August connects inventory, transfers, integrations, and exception work across HotWax Commerce, with clearer controls and stronger operational visibility.

items.title: HotWax turns Company into an integration control center
items.metaDescription: Company brings Shopify, NetSuite, carrier, Unigate, app-version, and batch-order controls into one HotWax Commerce administration workspace.

items.title: HotWax connects transfer-order creation, reservation, fulfillment, and receipt
items.metaDescription: HotWax Commerce connects transfer-order creation in Receiving with OMS reservation, fulfillment permissions, and NetSuite receipt imports.

items.title: HotWax connects Cycle Count creation with traceable variance decisions
items.metaDescription: Cycle Count adds count creation for store and admin teams, better review search, and a reusable history of inventory variance decisions.

items.title: HotWax adds a durable event ledger for Shopify inventory publishing
items.metaDescription: HotWax Commerce records inventory events in a durable ledger, batches Shopify updates safely, and exposes the publishing flow in Company.

items.title: HotWax turns Job Manager metrics into investigation paths
items.metaDescription: Job Manager turns dashboard metrics into exact drilldowns and compares Shopify Bulk Operations with their related HotWax processing state.

items.title: HotWax adds multi-company management and NetSuite subsidiary mapping
items.metaDescription: HotWax Commerce manages internal company hierarchies and maps company external IDs to NetSuite subsidiaries in the current order export flow.

items.title: HotWax keeps the Order Manager Funnel accurate as its scope changes
items.metaDescription: The Order Manager Funnel protects live scope changes from stale data and improves time, links, and progress indicators for daily operations.

items.title: HotWax brings returns and every non-dedicated hold into Order Manager
items.metaDescription: Order Manager adds return queues and details while making every hold outside dedicated Bad Address, Swap, and Fraud queues visible and actionable.

items.title: HotWax explains Online ATP and brings inventory update jobs into Order Routing
items.metaDescription: Order Routing explains how Online ATP is computed and adds schedules, queue state, Data Manager files, and run controls for inventory updates.

items.title: HotWax keeps Shopify fulfillment locations and OMS allocations aligned
items.metaDescription: HotWax Commerce reconciles Shopify fulfillment-location changes with OMS allocations while protecting inventory accuracy and preventing sync loops.
